activeQuestion.prompt: Lee has booked a session to replace a patterned button on a coat. Lee has a matching spare button that fits the buttonhole, but no thread. Which plan lets Lee keep the original button design?
activeQuestion.promptZh: Lee 已預約更換大衣上的一顆花紋鈕扣，手上有一顆同款備用鈕扣，大小也合乎扣眼，但沒有縫線。哪個做法能維持原有的鈕扣款式？

options.text: Bring only the coat and ask for one of the library's standard buttons.
options.zh: 只帶大衣，請志工使用圖書館提供的一般鈕扣。
options.whyZh: 圖書館只提供素白色鈕扣，並不是與大衣相配的花紋款式。

options.text: Bring matching thread and ask the volunteer to find a matching button on site.
options.zh: 自備相配的縫線，再請志工在現場找同款鈕扣。
options.whyZh: 自備縫線無法解決款式問題；現場不提供裝飾鈕扣。

options.text: Bring the matching spare button and use the library's thread.
options.zh: 帶同款備用鈕扣，使用圖書館提供的縫線。
options.whyZh: 備用鈕扣與原來同款，大小也合乎扣眼。圖書館提供一般縫線，Lee 不必自備。

options.text: Bring a button of a different design and use a matching color of thread.
options.zh: 帶一顆其他款式的鈕扣，再用相配顏色的縫線。
options.whyZh: 即使縫線顏色相配，其他款式的鈕扣也不會變成原有的款式。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 備用鈕扣與原來同款，大小也合乎扣眼。圖書館提供一般縫線，Lee 不必自備。
activeQuestion.evidence: Library supplies basic thread and only plain white buttons; booked volunteers can attach a bring-your-own button that fits the buttonhole.

vocabulary.note: 衣物上供鈕扣穿過的小孔。

group.title: Repair Day at Alder Library
group.titleZh: 阿爾德圖書館衣物修補日
group.passage:
Repair Day at Alder Library

Our volunteers can help with simple clothing repairs on Saturday. You must book a table session if you want a volunteer to sew your item. If you did not book, you can still join the drop-in line by the entrance. Volunteers at that desk will look at the damage and suggest what to do next, but they will not sew anything. Walk-in table sessions are available only if another visitor cancels.

Please bring your item clean and dry. We provide needles, basic thread and plain white buttons, but we do not stock decorative buttons. During a booked session, a volunteer can attach a button you bring if it fits the garment's buttonhole.

If your repair is not ready when you leave, the table volunteer will give you a numbered claim ticket. You may collect the item yourself or give the original ticket to someone who can pick it up for you. A photo of the ticket will not be accepted. The collection desk closes at 4 p.m. even though the library stays open until 6 p.m.
group.passageZh:
阿爾德圖書館衣物修補日

星期六，志工可協助簡單修補衣物。若需要志工動手縫補，須預約修補桌時段。未預約的人仍可到入口排隊諮詢。志工會查看損壞情形並建議下一步，但不提供縫補服務。只有其他人取消預約時，才會開放現場預約修補桌。

請帶來乾淨、乾燥的衣物。我們提供針、一般縫線和素白色鈕扣，但不提供裝飾鈕扣。預約時段內，如果自備的鈕扣能扣進衣物的扣眼，志工就能幫忙縫上。

離開時如果衣物還沒修好，修補桌志工會給你一張有編號的領取憑單。你可以自行領取，也可將憑單正本交給他人代領。櫃檯不接受憑單照片。圖書館雖然開到下午六點，領取櫃檯仍在下午四點關閉。

options.text: A payment deadline after the pilot build

options.text: A trial without an engineering drawing
